_about: Template for entry 0 of log.jsonl. tools/genesis.py prepare fills the placeholders and writes the canonical unsigned message; Guy signs it with the exact command below; tools/genesis.py assemble attaches the signature. CHARTER.md §§2-3 is the genesis text; its SHA-256 and the trusted-base digest are recorded in the body, and the judge refuses every proposal while trunk's CHARTER.md does not hash to the recorded value. Only a plain ssh-ed25519 key may sign at C0; a hardware key (sk-ssh-ed25519@openssh.com) signs a different message and must stop the procedure.
